question: The Ahilya fort was constructed in the 18th Century on the banks of ______ river.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ahilya Fort is in the central Indian town of Maheshwar.**
 
• **It sits high above the sacred river Narmada.**
 
• **Maharani Ahilyabai Holkar ruled here from 1765 to 1796 **and built Ahilya Wada. Later its name became the "Ahilya fort".
 
• Inside this fort was her personal residences, offices, and barbara audience hall.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ahilya Fort or palace sits on top of the 16th CE ramparts that were potentially built by the Mughals.**
 
• The palace is now a heritage hotel which means the residential part is open only to the guests staying here. 
 
• The Ahilya Fort Hotel has **19 rooms of character**, set in six buildings of the 18th century, with modern amenities and comforts.
 
• Guests stroll through **3 acres of courtyards, fountains, and gardens that link areas within the Wada.**
